claims_to_verify: Own opinions, no numbers or citations. Verdicts follow our tier lists: incline db press over barbell bench (chest A vs B), leg press over back squat (legs #1 vs B), lat pulldown over pull-ups (back #3 vs #5), cable curl over barbell curl (biceps S vs B), dips over push-ups (chest A vs B), romanian deadlift over deadlift (legs A, back B).
Ending: 'see which one actually moves your numbers' relies on workout logging only; no new feature claimed.
